Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandmother” (father’s mother) as “father’s father’s mother” (paternal great-grandmother). Despite confirming from King Cheng of Zhou’s page that his mother is Yi Jiang, the Planner incorrectly shifted to Tai Si (King Wu’s mother) as the answer. This reversal ignored the verified evidence and led to the wrong conclusion; the correct paternal grandmother of King Kang of Zhou is Yi Jiang.
